title: Asked to pay cash with no bill or receipt
triggers: asked to pay cash no receipt
pay cash and we won't add GST

rights.plain_explanation: Not issuing a bill, cash memo or receipt for goods sold or services given is an unfair trade practice.

do_now: Politely ask for a proper bill before paying.
Pay by UPI or card where you can, so there's a record.
If they refuse, you can buy elsewhere or report them.
notes: If someone in an official role (like a traffic officer) asks for cash without a receipt, ask for the official challan instead.
